name: GPU-based Slice Rendering with SculptBuffer
definition: A rendering technique that uses a 3D texture (SculptBuffer) on the GPU to store distances to a Surface of Reference Point (SRP) or modified volume boundary, allowing interactive sculpting (clipping, erasing, digging) via fragment shader operations.
summary: GPU-based Slice Rendering with SculptBuffer enables real-time interactive sculpting of volumetric data by using a GPU-stored 3D texture to discard fragments based on distance to a sculpted boundary.
